title: We've launched LOB-BO – a crypto market intelligence and analytics platform
author: Naive-Caregiver-9853
selftext:
Hi everyone,

We're excited to introduce **LOB-BO**, a cryptocurrency research and analytics platform we've been building.

🌐 [https://lob-bo.com](https://lob-bo.com/)

Our aim is to bring together crypto market intelligence, independent scoring, token discovery and simulated trading in one place.

Some of the features include:

• Market scanner and rankings  
• Independent market scoring  
• Technical charts and indicators  
• DEX pair discovery  
• Crypto Safety research  
• Market news and intelligence  
• Portfolio monitoring  
**• Simulated trading and strategy testing**

We've put a considerable amount of work into developing the platform, and we're now opening it up to the wider community.

We're particularly interested in feedback from people who actively research cryptocurrency markets.

What do you think? What would you improve? What features would make this genuinely useful?

We're happy to answer questions and hear honest feedback.

Thanks for checking it out!

**LOB-BO:** [https://lob-bo.com](https://lob-bo.com/)
